map.根据痛风分期及合并症，评估血尿酸靶目标及降尿酸治疗(ULT)方案: Assesses serum uric acid target and urate-lowering therapy (ULT) based on gout stage and comorbidities
map.心血管事件风险，CKD慎用: Cardiovascular risk; use cautiously in CKD
map.提示：急性发作期不启动ULT，已用药者不停药。ULT启动初期(3-6月)需联合秋: Note: do not start ULT during an acute flare; keep ongoing ULT. Prophylaxis with colchicine (0.5mg 1-2/d) for 3-6 months after starting ULT. Avoid lowering uric acid too much (<180μmol/L), possibly linked to neurodegeneration. Monitor every 2-4 weeks, then every 6 months once target reached. For clinical reference only.
map.血尿酸 520 μmol/L，慢性痛风石期目标 <300 μmol/L → 差: Uric acid 520 μmol/L, chronic tophaceous target <300 μmol/L → gap 220, not at target; start allopurinol/febuxostat with low-dose colchicine for 3-6 months, recheck in 3 months.
map.血尿酸 340 μmol/L，无石期目标 <360 → 达标，维持 ULT 并随: Uric acid 340 μmol/L, non-tophaceous target <360 → at target, maintain ULT and monitor renal function.
map.无石 <360、有石/慢性/反复 <300 μmol/L；达标可溶解尿酸盐结晶、: Non-tophaceous <360, tophaceous/chronic/recurrent <300 μmol/L; target dissolves urate crystals and reduces flares.
map.急性期能加药吗？: Can medication be added during acute phase?
map.急性发作期不停已有 ULT，但不新启动；新启动应等炎症消退后。: Keep ongoing ULT during flares but do not start new; start after inflammation subsides.
